DISCOVERED ISSUE: A record update that adds a NEW ALL-CAPS section (for example `@@eat/ninja_sushi` with `- MUST ORDER` / `  - Dragon roll`) writes `## Must Order` with no blank line before it: directly after the closing code fence of `## Source` on migrated notes, or after the last `## Notes` bullet on bob-created notes. Create inserts the blank line correctly.

Repro on master f231b9d3 with installed bob 0.5.0 in a throwaway vault: bob capture --dry-run -- "$(printf '%s\n' '@eat/ninja_sushi' '- MUST ORDER' '  - Dragon roll')" prints the fence line immediately followed by '## Must Order'; a real commit writes the same bytes.

Root cause: src/native/records/render.rs append_section_bullets, no-matching-heading branch (~line 1552), pushes the blank separator only when the last body line is non-blank AND has an empty line ending (a file without a trailing newline). A normal file ending in a newline skips the separator.

Fix: push a blank line whenever the last body line is non-blank, regardless of its ending; add goldens for notes ending in a fence and in a bullet. Impact: cosmetic (Obsidian still renders the heading) but breaks the note style. Found while researching record-note UX (research:202611/record_notes_capture_ux.md).

payload.entry: RESOLVED (note #6): the .addTo exhaustive-switch build break is fixed on master by 3131414 (j9.3 typing-tips commit, which bundled the adaptation). Root cause: ir.12 commit a5152aa added case addTo to CaptureRelatedAction in Sources/CaptureCore/CaptureRelatedModels.swift without adapting the three exhaustive switches in the BobMacCapture target (CapturePanelModel.completeSimilarTaskIDAssignment, CapturePanelView.linkInsertsLine(for:) inner switch under case .similarTask, CapturePanelView.similarTaskInsertsText(route:typed:action:)). Why it shipped: ir.12 note #1 claims 'swift build + swift test green' with 'Mac typecheck/macos-ci not run from Linux'; just portable-check cannot type-check Sources/BobMacCapture*, and the scratch Mac compile plus Scripts/macos-ci-check that bob-mac-capture AGENTS.md requires never ran before the phase closed. Impact: master red at Build since a5152aa (runs 42672189863 and 42673185238), and Bryan's just install-all failed on the Mac 2026-11-09 13:54 EST. The fix adds no-task-ID .addTo cases in all three switches (landed bodies return empty rather than the tale's draft 'Updates record text'; equivalent since unreachable: record rows emit requires_block_id None in src/native/capture_related/records.rs, so similarApply and the pending-action path only present the ID prompt when requiresBlockID is true, and the model branch reports the update-Bob error and never splices). Mac just portable-check green on the linked checkout (2390 tests, 0 failures). install_excerpt outcome: fixed in bob-cli scripts/lib/install_ui/live.py _failure_excerpt, which now starts the 40-line excerpt at the first case-sensitive real diagnostic label ((?:^|[\s:])error(?:\[[^\]]*\])?: matching swiftc file:line:col error:, rustc error[E...]:, cargo/just error:, Swift caret |- error:) before falling back to the old case-insensitive substring and then the last 20 lines. This is why the reported output hid the errors: every Swift 6 warning ends 'this is an error in the Swift 6 language mode', so the old substring search started the excerpt at the first Sendable warning (log line 7) and the real errors at lines 496-558 were never shown.
